_note: General adult reference values (rda = daily target, ul = upper limit) used by Forge's ingredient-level Analyze card. Not personalized by age/sex/pregnancy, and not medical advice. Edit this file directly in the repo to update the numbers — Forge re-fetches it about once a day, no app rebuild needed. Units: fiber/sugar/satfat in g, sodium/chol/calcium/iron/potassium/magnesium/zinc in mg, vitA/vitD/vitK/b12/folate in mcg, vitC/vitE/b6 in mg.
